# demo-room

A synthetic 4 x 5 m room that the mock provider serves when `MOCK_OUTPUTS_SET=demo-room` (D-01/D-02).
It is generated by `scripts/make-demo-room.ts` (run `npm run demo-room` from `backend/`; needs ffmpeg).
The output is deterministic (seeded PRNG). It is fully synthetic, so there is no license and no real home data.

All geometry is in `spaitial-world-v1` (metres, +Y up, floor = XZ). The room spans x [-2, 2], z [-2.5, 2.5],
and the walls go up to y = 2.5. The z = +2.5 wall (blue) has a 0.9 x 2.1 m doorway. The other walls are
red (z = -2.5), green (x = -2) and mustard (x = +2). There is a table and a white cabinet.

- `splat.ply`: about 72k gaussians in a binary little-endian 3DGS PLY with the same 14 properties as
  mock-outputs. The floor is a checkerboard, so a mirrored or flipped load is easy to spot.
- `collider.ply`: an ASCII mesh with a floor quad, 2 cm wall slabs and the furniture boxes. Faces point outward.
- `floorplan.png` + `floorplan.json`: a 0.02 m/px top-down plan with exact inverse `image` affines.
- `cameras.json`: `spaitial.capture_cameras.v1`. It has 24 frames on a 0.7 m loop at y = 1.5, and
  `camera_from_splat = F · inv(T_three) · F`.
- `thumbnail.jpg`: a 1200x630 preview of the plan in the room colours.
